You’ll work with operational IT teams, suppliers, Incident Managers and Duty Managers to coordinate responses, while keeping customers and key stakeholders informed throughout. Manage critical (MI), major (P1) and degradation (P2) incidents outside of core business hours. Assess, prioritise and triage incidents, escalating to the appropriate resolver teams when required. Coordinate with operational IT teams, suppliers, Incident Managers and Duty Managers during major incidents and service outages. Participate in incident bridge calls and maintain accurate incident records, timelines, actions and communications. Deliver remote troubleshooting and resolution for hardware, software and access issues wherever possible. Work to agreed SLAs and KPIs, ensuring incidents and customer contacts are managed within contractual targets. Experience working in a customer-focused environment where delivering excellent service is a priority. Experience of incident management, including recognising and appropriately escalating high-severity incidents. The confidence to work independently and make sound decisions in a pressurised environment. Excellent customer service, communication and interpersonal skills. A logical and methodical approach to troubleshooting and problem solving. Experience diagnosing hardware and software issues. The ability to manage competing priorities while working to strict SLAs and KPIs. Strong attention to detail, particularly when recording incidents, actions and customer communications. Experience using a Service Management System. ServiceNow experience would be advantageous but is not essential. Experience with remote support tools would be advantageous. A proactive approach to identifying opportunities for service and process improvement. The flexibility and ability to work a 24-hour rotating shift pattern. The ability to obtain and maintain Full SC Clearance, where required by the contracts supported. A strong commitment to security, confidentiality and professional conduct. The Shift Pattern This is an out-of-hours role, so flexibility to work a rotating shift pattern is essential. You’ll work a repeating 4-on, 4-off pattern, alternating between day and night shifts: 4 day shifts → 4 days off → 4 day shifts → 4 days off → 4 night shifts → 4 nights off → 4 night shifts → 4 nights off Then the pattern repeats. Where will you work? Day shifts Monday to Friday: Office based. Night shifts and weekends: Home working is available. As a global team of 50,000 people across Defence, Transport, Justice, Immigration, Healthcare, Leisure and Citizen Services, we’re united by a shared purpose: to improve the services that communities rely on. review_candidates.title: First Line Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Wij zijn… Ascom is een internationale aanbieder van ICT-oplossingen en mobiele workflowoplossingen voor de gezondheidszorg en de zakelijke markt. Met ons hoofdkantoor in Zwitserland en aanwezigheid in 18 landen, ondersteunen we de zorg al 160 jaar met onze technologie. Hiermee stellen wij de gezondheidszorg in staat om de best mogelijke zorg aan te bieden. Onze systemen worden in 12.000 verschillende ziekenhuizen over de wereld gebruikt en hiermee verwerken zij meer dan 800 miljoen alarmen per jaar (meer dan 2 miljoen alarmen per dag!). Onze oplossingen hebben een positieve invloed op levens van mensen die in deze ziekenhuizen of zorginstellingen verblijven. We hebben grote ambities om te groeien en we hebben jou daarbij nodig! Wat ga je doen? Als First Line Support Engineer ga je aan de slag met het beantwoorden van vragen van klanten van Ascom. Je ondersteunt hen via telefoon en e-mail en lost eenvoudige technische problemen op. Bovendien verzamel je informatie voor het oplossen van complexere problemen en documenteer je de vragen en oplossingen in een ticketsysteem. Naast het beantwoorden van klantenvragen voer je ook eenvoudige wijzigingen en onderhoud uit. Je samenwerking met andere afdelingen zorgt ervoor dat klanten tevreden zijn en hun problemen snel worden opgelost. Je komt te werken in een gezellig team van ong. 15 collega’s die werken als eerste- en tweedelijns support engineer. MBO werk- en denkniveau Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Je staat regelmatig in contact met de klant en je moet daarbij goed kunnen door kunnen vragen. review_candidates.title: Control Assessor (BCC Cairo)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Control Assessor (BCC Cairo) Egypt Full time We Make Health Happen The core purpose of this role is to deliver first line Key Control testing across UKI, including Functions, and to support Bupa Global control testing activity where required. Reporting into the Key Control Manager in BCC Cairo, the Control Assessor will perform testing in line with agreed scripts, methodology, evidence standards and timelines, helping the first line evidence that controls are designed and operating effectively. The role will identify and clearly articulate control findings, agree appropriate actions with control owners, maintain high-quality records and support continuous improvement of the control environment, with a strong focus on customer outcomes, regulatory expectations and operational discipline. How You’ll Help Us Make Health Happen As our Control Assessor you will be responsible for completing first line Key Control testing across UKI, including Functions, and supporting Bupa Global activity where required. You will work closely with the Key Control Manager, business control owners, UKI stakeholders and Risk and Compliance colleagues to assess whether key controls are operating effectively, ensure testing conclusions are evidence based, and help drive timely remediation where weaknesses are identified. Conduct Key Control testing in line with documented testing scripts, agreed methodology, evidence standards and defined timelines, ensuring consistency and quality across UKI testing activity. Assess the design and operating effectiveness of key controls, using sound judgement to determine whether controls are suitably evidenced and operating as intended. Document testing outcomes clearly and accurately, ensuring conclusions, evidence, gaps and rationale are recorded to a high standard and can withstand review by management, Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit or regulators. Agree SMART actions with control owners where deficiencies are identified, and support tracking and follow-up activity through to satisfactory closure. Provide concise written and verbal feedback to control owners and stakeholders, explaining findings, evidence expectations and required remediation in a clear, constructive and professional manner. Support control testing across regulated activities, customer outcomes, operational resilience, conduct risk, financial crime, data quality, third party oversight and other UKI priority control areas as required. Contribute to control performance reporting, findings summaries and action tracking updates by providing accurate testing status, themes, issues and supporting commentary. Maintain strong working relationships with the Key Control Manager, UKI business control owners, Functional teams, Bupa Global colleagues and Risk and Compliance stakeholders, recognising the importance of collaboration in strengthening control ownership. Identify and escalate control issues, evidence gaps, recurring themes and opportunities to improve control documentation, testing scripts, reporting quality and ways of working. Support preparation for RCSA activity, second line assurance reviews, Internal Audit activity and regulatory queries by ensuring testing records, evidence and action updates are complete, timely and accurate. Keep up to date with relevant regulatory, policy and operational requirements, and complete all required training to support effective delivery of control testing responsibilities. Key Skills/Qualifications Needed For This Role Experience in control testing, assurance, monitoring, operations, compliance, risk management or a regulated business environment is desirable. Understanding of processes, risks and key control points, with the ability to evaluate whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively. Awareness of FCA rules, conduct expectations, ICOBS principles and Treating Customers Fairly requirements, and how these apply to Bupa’s regulated activities and customer experience. Ability to follow defined testing scripts and methodology, gather relevant evidence, assess evidence quality and document clear testing conclusions. Sound reasoning, critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify control gaps, assess potential impact and recommend proportionate remediation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to explain findings, evidence requirements and agreed actions clearly and constructively to varied stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and high standards of record keeping, data quality and evidence management. Ability to manage allocated work independently, prioritise effectively, meet deadlines and escalate promptly where support, clarification or decisions are required. Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across UKI, Functions, Bupa Global, BCC Cairo and second and third line colleagues. PC literate, with sound knowledge of Microsoft applications and the ability to use risk, control, workflow or reporting tools as required. The jobholder works in a regulated environment and must operate in line with regulatory, operational, policy and testing methodology requirements. In any situation of uncertainty, the jobholder must refer to the Key Control Manager or relevant accountable owner. Why Bupa? Bupa Global is the international health insurance division of Bupa. We provide customers who want premium international coverage with products and services to access the healthcare they need anytime, around the world, whether at home or when studying, living, travelling or working abroad. Bupa Global has offices around the world including London and Brighton (UK), Dublin (Europe), Miami (USA), Dubai (UAE, in partnership with Sukoon), Egypt and Hong Kong (China) as well as regional offices in mainland Singapore, the Dominican Republic, Bolivia, Panama, Guatemala and Ecuador. Time Type Full time Job Area Locations: Egypt - Cairo
